parsed.name: 集群任务工作器
parsed.description: 用于实验数据处理集群的非物理软件组件。它会持续轮询任务队列、获取待处理任务、执行配方型计算流程，并将结果返回到上游队列或服务。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for experimental data-processing clusters. It continuously polls task queues, fetches pending jobs, executes recipe-based computation workflows, and returns results to an upstream queue or service.

actions.description: 持续运行工作器主循环。
actions.description_en: Run the worker main loop continuously.

actions.description: 轮询任务队列并获取新的待计算任务。
actions.description_en: Poll task queues and fetch new tasks for computation.

actions.description: 持续返回已完成任务的结果。
actions.description_en: Continuously return results for completed tasks.

actions.description: 处理已入队任务，加载输入并执行配方计算。
actions.description_en: Process queued tasks, load inputs, and execute recipe-based computations.
